
## Albedo experiment

```{r}
#| label: albedo_experiment
albedo_experiment <- function(experiment) {
  old <- rcdo::cdo_cache_set(here::here("data/temp/cache"))
  on.exit(rcdo::cdo_cache_set(old))
  box::use(R / functions[dir_part])

  temp_era_full <- here::here("data/derived/era5_temp_antarctic_mon.nc")

  files <- "/g/data/rt52/era5/single-levels/monthly-averaged/2t/*/*.nc" |>
    Sys.glob()

  years <- as.numeric(dir_part(files, 1))

  files <- files[years > 1979]
  grid <- CDR_grid()

  files |>
    lapply(
      \(x) {
        x |>
          rcdo::cdo_remapbil(grid = grid)
      }
    ) |>
    rcdo::cdo_mergetime() |>
    rcdo::cdo_setday(1) |>
    rcdo::cdo_settime("00:00:00") |>
    rcdo::cdo_execute(
      output = temp_era_full,
      options = "-O -L -b f32",
      cache = TRUE
    )
  return(temp_era_full)
}
```


```{r}
#| label: grid_albedo
grid_albedo <- function(experiment) {
  air_var <- "fld_s03i236"

  sel_air <- function(x) {
    x |>
      cdo_selname(air_var) |>
      cdo_remapbil("r360x180") |>
      cdo_sellonlatbox(0, 360, -90, -50)
  }

  exp_air <- glue::glue(
    "/scratch/lo70/sd3017/access-esm/atmos_component/{experiment}/archive/output*/atmosphere/netCDF/aiihca.pa*.nc"
  ) |>
    Sys.glob() |>
    lapply(sel_air) |>
    cdo_mergetime() |>
    cdo_chname(air_var, "tas") |>
    cdo_setday(1) |>
    cdo_settime("00:00:00") |>
    cdo_execute()

  sel_ice <- function(x) {
    x |>
      cdo_selname("aice") |>
      cdo_remapbil("r360x180") |>
      cdo_sellonlatbox(0, 360, -90, -50)
  }

  exp_ice <- glue::glue(
    "/scratch/lo70/sd3017/access-esm/atmos_component/{experiment}/archive/output*/ice/HISTORY/*.nc"
  ) |>
    Sys.glob() |>
    lapply(sel_ice) |>
    cdo_mergetime() |>
    cdo_setday(1) |>
    cdo_settime("00:00:00") |>
    cdo_chname("aice", "siconc") |>
    cdo_mulc(100) |>
    cdo_execute()

  grid_ice(exp_ice, exp_air)[, experiment := experiment]
}
```



```{r}
#| label: grid_experiments
grid_experiments <- c("all_albedo_0", "all_albedo_0.2", "all_albedo_0.99") |>
  lapply(grid_albedo) |>
  rbindlist()
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 7
```
